name: Hand-built weir or small pond · 2 m
notes: Hand-built weir or small pond, 2 m high (crest 85.9 m), full at 85.8 m: about 72 m³ (0.07 ML) over 120 m², 1.8 m deep at the wall. Catchment 5.6 ha.
